Canonical 9.0 is the mainnet exit: instant trustless unwrap to stETH, then the Lido withdrawal queue (1-5 days, no gating), or the deepest LST market in DeFi. WETH-exit TVL enumerated 2026-10-03 (DexTracker): ethereum >=$116.8M, base >=$9,483,030, monad $2,112.48. ⚠️ THE TWO LARGE FIGURES ARE FLOORS (GeckoTerminal truncates at 10 pages) AND monad IS A COMPLETE ENUMERATION (pool_list_truncated: false) — so the monad-to-mainnet gap is a LOWER BOUND and can only be wider. The truncation falls on the safe side for this comparison. ⚠️⚠️ monad IS SCORED SEPARATELY AT 2.0 AND THAT IS NOT A DEDUCTION ON THE CANONICAL NUMBER. Its venue ladder is a CLIFF AT THE SECOND RUNG, not a slope: KyberSwap routed exit 2026-10-03, -69bps at $1,000 on a 0.993 fill, then -7,207bps at $10,000 on a 0.279 fill. $10,000 in, $2,793 out. There is no usable band above $1,000 and the endpoints must never be quoted alone — interpolating between -69bps and -9,984bps gives a materially wrong answer. 2% depth $1,000, status bracketed, is_floor false, ladder_exhausted false, no failed rungs, transport_gap_note None: a real measurement of a real absence, not a coverage gap. ✅ AND THE EXIT IS THE CCIP BRIDGE, WHICH IS READ RATHER THAN ASSUMED: binding direction outbound, capacity 2,000 wstETH, refill 0.023148/s, both buckets refilling fully in 24.00h, measured with a negative control (chain_selector 1 returns disabled_all_zero_bucket both ends) and with ethereum's selector derived from the monad pool's own getSupportedChains(). Producer convention: is_enabled false means NO CAP and disabled capacities publish as null, not zero. ⚠️ THE SYSTEMIC FIGURE IMPROVED AS THE MARKET SHRANK, stated in both directions: 2,000/day was 9.44% of monad supply at 21,188 (10-03) and is 12.14% against 16,471 (10-09), so a full exit of every monad holder now takes ~8.2 days rather than ~10.6. It binds a crowd, not us. ⚠️ What a measured limiter does NOT retire: 2,000/day is a CONFIGURED value set by the same party that can call withdrawLiquidity on the collateral.

dependencies.underlying_score_basis: MEASURES THE COUNTERPARTY SET — how many, how concentrated, how substitutable — NOT the credit quality of those counterparties. A good counterparty at 100% is still 100%. Lido is a sole issuer with no substitution path: it operates the staking protocol, the withdrawal queue and the stETH claim, and a holder cannot change issuer while holding it. ⚠️ THE DIVERSIFICATION BENEATH LIDO IS REAL AND IT IS THE WRONG KIND — ~30+ curated operators plus permissionless CSM entry means the ASSET is diversified while the COUNTERPARTY is not, and this axis measures the counterparty. Placed one notch above weETH (5.5) on substitutability rather than size: Lido's operator set is materially larger, CSM makes operator entry permissionless so the set is replaceable from below, and the withdrawal path has cleared real volume over years rather than being assumed. ⚠️ Lido's ~28% share of all staked ETH is DELIBERATELY NOT PRICED HERE — it is a systemic fact about Ethereum and argues both directions for a holder's counterparty set; it is carried on Contract & Admin as the binding cap. ✅ FIRST REALISED TEST, 2026-09-30, AND IT HELD: a curated operator suffered an infrastructure compromise and exited its entire Lido position (~230,000 ETH, ~2.3-2.5% of the protocol), non-custodial throughout, absorbed with no holder action required. Scored as CONFIRMATION, not a new deduction — a confirmed prediction is not new information. ⚠️⚠️ ONE LEG OF THIS NUMBER IS UNANCHORED AND IS DECLARED RATHER THAN IMPLIED: [[eth]] carries underlying_score 10.0 so there is no inversion, but [[steth]] — the IMMEDIATE underlying — carries NO underlying_score at all (verified 2026-10-09, zero hits). Per axis-4-dependencies.md: score it first or say plainly that this number is unanchored. steth is not held; scoring it is a follow-up, not a blocker, and is deliberately NOT bundled into this refresh because scoring an unheld sibling on the way past is the corpus-sweep shape this backlog exists to avoid. ⚠️ NOT A PURE WRAPPER — staking inserts an operator between holder and underlying, so equal-don't-notch does not reach this pair. ⚠️ DELIBERATELY CLEAN OF AXIS-5 CONTENT: the 4-of-42 threshold, the 8-of-69 bypass and the 3h delay are AUTHORITY facts, priced once on Contract & Admin. weETH's own refresh was cut for exactly that double-charge.
